title: Filtered long-code CSP optimum bound
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with label set $[q]$, where $[q]$ is nonempty, and let a finite predicate family $\Psi$ contain every predicate used by a randomized tester. Choose a uniform refinement $R$ of the tester’s induced weighted constraint experiment, and integers $r,M$ with $0<M$ and $r\le M$, such that every tester predicate has arity at most $r$. If every dictator check is accepted with probability at least $\beta$, and the optimum value of the CSP associated with $G$ is at least $1-\delta$, then the optimum value of the globally filtered long-code CSP built from $G$, the tester, $R$, and the clone parameters $r,M$ is at least $\beta-r\delta-r^2/M$.
hypotheses_covered: The game has decidable equality on its finite vertex set
The predicate family Ψ is finite
Every predicate used by the tester belongs to Ψ
R is a uniform refinement of the induced weighted experiment
r and M are natural numbers

Every dictator check has acceptance probability at least β
The game CSP optimum is at least 1−δ
